title: Section map assembly for a cochain realization
statement: For a scheme X, module sheaves F,G and a computing resolution pairing D, there is a family of degree maps satisfying the section formula on every nonnegative bidegree.

proof.text: Linearize each restriction-compatible sectionwise bilinear pairing through the sheaf tensor universal property and assemble the maps on the total tensor coproduct.
